parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
>For hybrid cloud scenarios only, you can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query the hybrid cloud clusters.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: MatchedHost
parameters.description: The domain name or IP address.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The detection type. Valid values:

*   **api**: API-related domain names
*   **abnormal**: risk-related domain names
*   **event**: security event-related domain names

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-matched-hosts --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-x0r37plpl0g --matched-host bc.aliyun.com --page-number 1 --page-size 8 --type event --cluster-id 433 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aekz5qqo7jthcsa --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
